decisions.reason: As a close-to-core yogurt product with an earlier award signal and four years of apparent survival, it is likely performing at or above aspiration levels and should be retained.
This semi-hard cheese fits the established cheese business closely, and continued presence by 2022 suggests no clear shortfall severe enough to trigger withdrawal.

Because this spicy cheese line already received a broader multi-variant commitment, management would usually keep it unless results clearly fell below aspirations, for which there is no direct evidence here.
The mild creamy soft cheese is a conventional extension of the firm's core organic cheese offer, so with no visible sign of underperformance it would likely remain in the range.
This washed-rind soft cheese is the most niche of the surviving products and therefore faces the highest review risk, but survival until 2022 still makes retention more likely than withdrawal.
